description: Edit a program's intake definition. Send only the keys you change; null clears one. Every change is saved as a new version that can be restored. A change that removes or changes items open requests already hold answers for is refused with the impact until you repeat it with acknowledgeImpact; use dryRun to see the impact first. Filed requests are never re-gated.

acknowledgeImpact.description: Proceed although the change removes or changes items open requests hold answers for. Set it only after reviewing the impact a first attempt returned.

checklist.description: The form: a list of items, in the order they are asked. null clears the program's own definition so its checklist skill (if any) applies again. Each item needs id (lowercase letters, digits, underscores), label and kind.

allOption.description: multichoice only: one extra "all of the above" choice, { label: "All of the above" }. Picking it records every option value, so tags and filters see each option.

check.description: link_or_document only: the platform fetches each link the answer holds, and the item counts only while they answer. An uploaded file needs no check.

group.description: A heading to group items under in the request view.

id.description: Stable key answers are stored under. Never rename one that has answers.

options.description: choice and multichoice only: at least two.

recheckAfterMs.description: A verified_status or a link with check: reachable only: milliseconds the platform's last check stays good for a build, from 3600000 (1 hour) to 30 days. Older, a build asks for a new check first. Unset: a checked link goes stale after one day; a verified status never does.

report.description: Include the item in the request summary report.

requiredBy.description: When a required (fail) answer is due: filing (default) blocks filing; build lets the request be filed without it but holds engineering until it is provided.

severity.description: fail (default) blocks filing; warn is shown as a gap only.

when.description: Ask only when earlier choice, multichoice or boolean items have these answers: { itemId: value | [values] }. For a multichoice the condition holds when any selected option is listed.

why.description: Why the team needs it; shown to the interviewer.

checklistName.description: What the checklist is called ("Integration checklist").

customInstructions.description: Interview instructions for this program, 4000 characters at most.

dryRun.description: Return what the change would do to open drafts and write nothing.

ifRevision.description: The `revision` you read; the change is refused if the program moved since.

reason.description: Why, kept on the version and in the audit event (300 characters at most).

name: anyforge_set_program_intake_definition
title: Set program intake definition
